controls.label: Shape
controls.qualification: A sphere of the published angular diameter; the neutral gray is a display convention, not a measured colour or brightness.
controls.notes: No image of the photosphere is cast here. The public 2014 VLTI/PIONIER visibilities do not fit a single image (see the investigation ledger) and the published VLTI/AMBER movies are not deposited as data. Neutral gray marks an unresolved surface; the display axis is celestial north, a convention.
